item.title: Calling Rust From PHP Without a Socket, Part 1: The Native Functions
item.description: ePHPm is a single Rust binary that embeds PHP, and it carries its own KV store and its own SQLite-backed database in the same process. For a long time the only way PHP code could reach that KV store was the same way it reaches Redis: open a TCP socket to the RESP listener ePHPm runs on localhost, encode a command, wait for the reply. That works, and every PHP Redis client in existence already speaks it, but it is a strange thing to do when the hash map you’re talking to lives a few pointers away in the same address space.
